# Ecosystems with the Frontend

The Verana Frontend is the console of a corporation: members and operators, ecosystems and governance frameworks, credential schemas, the participants it accredits, its trust deposit, its pending validations. These guides follow the [ecosystem builder's path](./00-path.md).

| Step | Guides |
|---|---|
| First steps | [get started with the frontend](./05-get-started.md): wallet, Get VNA, the acting corporation, the pages |
| Corporation | [create a corporation](./10-create-corporation.md), [operators, proposals and fee grants](./11-operators-proposals.md), [corporation governance framework](./12-corporation-governance.md) |
| Ecosystem | [create an ecosystem and publish its governance framework](./20-create-ecosystem.md), [run the ecosystem anchor](./21-ecosystem-anchor.md) |
| Schemas and tree | [define a credential schema](./30-credential-schemas.md), [root participants and grantors](./31-root-participants-grantors.md) |
| Join | [join an ecosystem](./35-join-an-ecosystem.md) from a schema's participant tree, the applicant's side |
| Operate | [validate applicants](./40-validate-applicants.md), [revoke, slash and repay](./41-revoke-slash-repay.md) |
| Money | [design the fee model](./50-fee-model.md) |
| Identity for your sector | [offer identity schemas for your sector](./60-identity-schemas-for-your-sector.md) |

Guides are written against the frontend 0.18 and the v4 testnet; `verified_on` in each front matter says when they were last run end to end. The screenshots come from a demo corporation and ecosystem on testnet, and follow the light or dark theme of these docs; click one to enlarge it.
